SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I. Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 9924
Station 40
Date April 4, 1940

Subject. Ronald Laurie Stuart Hill

Made by. D. S. McKeown Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford

Ronald Laurie Stuart Hill styling himself
Dental Surgeon, with an office and flat at 39
Peking Road, came to Shanghai from Australia
in 1936. He was trained by his father who
was a dental surgeon from the year 1919 to 1929.
He is permitted by the Dental Board of Victoria
to practise dentistry under the supervision of
dentists. There is no proof that he holds a
degree as he is not registered as a university
graduate. He is accepted on the Shanghai
Medical list as apprentice trained hence the
title of "doctor" which he uses is merely one
of courtesy. When he first came to Shanghai
he acted as assistant to Dr. M.E. Klatchko, but
about one year ago, he purchased his present
practice from the firm of Drs. Ivy, Spence and
Robinson. He is assisted by his wife who acts
as nurse and by a European emigrant. He has a
large clientele and is recommended by everyone
as a highly efficient practitioner. He is a member
of the French Club and has a large circle of
friends and acquaintances.

There is nothing to his detriment in Police
records and nothing is known at present regarding
his association with Morgan but this point will
be borne in mind.

D. S.
D. C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别分部
报告
档案编号 9924
第40巡捕房
日期 1940年4月4日

事由：罗纳德·劳里·斯图尔特·希尔（Ronald Laurie Stuart Hill）

制作人：D. S. McKeown 转呈人：D. I. Crawford

罗纳德·劳里·斯图尔特·希尔自称牙科医师，在北京路39号设有诊所及公寓，于1936年从澳大利亚来到上海。他由其父亲培训，其父在1919年至1929年间为一名牙科医师。维多利亚州牙科委员会允许他在牙医的监督下从事牙科执业。没有证据表明他拥有学位，因为他并未注册为大学毕业生。他被列入上海医生名录，注明为学徒受训出身，因此他所使用的“医生”头衔仅为一种尊称。初到上海时，他曾担任M.E. Klatchko医生的助手，但约一年前，他从Ivy、Spence和Robinson医生事务所购得了目前的执业权。他的妻子担任护士协助他，另有一名欧洲移民协助。他拥有庞大的客户群，并被众人推荐为一位非常高效的从业者。他是法国总会会员，拥有广泛的朋友和熟人圈子。

警方记录中没有任何对他不利的内容，目前也不了解他与摩根（Morgan）的关联，但此点将予以留意。

D. S.
警司（特别分部）

Memorandum
OFFICE OF
THE AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT TRADE
COMMISSIONER IN CHINA
12 The Bund
Shanghai, 4 / 4 / 1940.
To Commissioner N.W. Yorke
Special Branch

Dear Mr Yorke, Many thanks indeed for
the information sent me yesterday. It is so
illuminating that I should like to take advantage
of your offer by asking if you know anything
concerning another Australian:
Dr H. Stuart Hill
39 Peking Rd.
He is practising as a dentist & appears to be doing
very well, though so far as I know he is not
'qualified'. He came from Australia a few years ago
and worked for a time under Dr Matchett.
P.C.

备忘录
澳大利亚政府驻中国贸易专员公署
外滩12号
上海，1940年4月4日。

致 N.W. Yorke 专员
特别分部

亲爱的Yorke先生：非常感谢您昨天发给我的信息。该信息极具启发性，我想借此机会接受您的提议，询问您是否了解另一位澳大利亚人的情况：
H. Stuart Hill 医生
北京路39号
他作为一名牙科医师执业，似乎经营得很好，尽管据我所知他并不具备“资格”。他几年前从澳大利亚来此，并曾在Matchett医生手下工作过一段时间。
P.C.
